rationale: platformio.ini only advances LESHY1_VERSION; board, partitions and build flags remain unchanged. The runtime delta is confined to the existing user-started Full/Guided Self-Test and sequentially reuses already accepted receive-only nRF24, CC1101 OOK/FSK and IR adapters under the existing RadioSpi lease. It adds bounded samples, FSK ISR drain, report facts and mandatory cleanup without adding a transmit API or changing product capture/storage formats.
required_host_checks: full host/source/docs suite in tracked-evidence mode
bounded S5 RX adapter and no-TX source contract
exact firmware build and resource budget
required_hil_scenarios: one public Full/Guided run through nRF24, CC1101 spectrum, OOK, FSK and IR receive smoke
FSK ISR queue drained without overflow and all S5 receive checks passed
disposable scratch removed with product CID, generation and observations unchanged
zero radio TX commands, input drops and final ownership
